title: SummaryToTicketGenerator
description: Body of the OpenAI Responses API request (POST /v1/responses) that process-summary sends to start ticket extraction, exactly as sent: the versioned prompt as instructions, the meeting summary as input, a stored background response, and the ticket format as a strict structured-output format. The response is receipt_id_to_process_summary.

name.description: Name of the output format, as OpenAI requires.

schema.description: The ticket_format_to_ticket_generator schema, exactly as in that file but without its $schema keyword. Strict mode needs a plain root schema, so it is sent verbatim (architecture decision 26). A JSON Schema cannot say "equals another file", so tests compare it with the file.

background.description: Run in background mode: OpenAI answers at once and calls the webhook when done.

store.description: Keep the response so it can be retrieved however late the webhook arrives.
